landing.heroMainHeading: Your Smart Partner for Starting and Growing Your Business
landing.heroSubText: VyaparMitra helps local and rural entrepreneurs make smarter business, financial, and investment decisions with personalized, AI-powered guidance.
landing.stripHeading: Built to make business decisions simpler
landing.aboutDesc: VyaparMitra is an AI-driven business advisory and financial assistance platform designed to help entrepreneurs understand business opportunities, estimate investments, plan finances, analyze local market conditions, and make informed decisions. We focus on making complex business and financial information easy to understand for everyone.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything You Need to Make Better Business Decisions
landing.cardAdvisorDesc: Get personalized business recommendations based on your unique situation.
landing.cardInsightsDesc: Understand opportunities, demand, competition, and business conditions in a specific location.
landing.cardFinancialDesc: Estimate investment, expenses, revenue, profitability, and financial requirements.
landing.cardAnalysisDesc: Understand how much capital may be required and evaluate potential business opportunities.
landing.cardSchemeDesc: Help users identify potentially relevant financial assistance, loans, subsidies, and government schemes.
landing.cardGrowthDesc: Provide practical recommendations to improve and grow your business.
landing.cardLanguageDesc: Allow users to interact with the platform in their preferred Indian regional language.
landing.cardPlanDesc: Generate recommendations based on your business type, location, investment capacity, and goals.
landing.step1Desc: Enter your business idea, location, investment capacity, and requirements.
landing.step2Desc: The platform evaluates business, financial, and local-market factors.
landing.step3Desc: Receive recommendations tailored to your situation.
landing.step4Desc: Use the insights to plan, start, improve, or grow your business.
landing.hyperLocalHeading: Business Advice That Understands Your Location
landing.hyperLocalDesc: Different locations can have entirely different market demand, customer behavior, competition, investment requirements, operating costs, and business opportunities. VyaparMitra doesn't provide generic recommendations—it maps the local business ecosystem to give you precise guidance.
landing.financeHeading: Understand Your Financial Requirements Before You Invest
landing.langSubText: Technology should not be a language barrier. VyaparMitra is designed to make business guidance accessible in Indian regional languages.
landing.benefit8: Support for entrepreneurs at different stages
landing.ctaHeading: Ready to Turn Your Business Idea Into a Plan?
landing.ctaSubText: Start with VyaparMitra and get personalized guidance for your next business decision.
landing.footerDesc: VyaparMitra is an AI-driven platform empowering local and rural entrepreneurs with personalized, location-aware business advice and financial planning.
